scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute is infeasible inside the lightweight verifier sandbox; scoring relies on result-level comparison of agent-reported values to paper gold with tolerances, plus structural trend checks (site ordering). This matches the approved verification method.

hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded from the paper's reported values for Si5 atop_capped, atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values trace directly to the published table; they are the same quantities the reference oracle writes.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold structural parameters for Si5 short-bridge complex
hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded from the paper's reported C-C bond length, Si-C bond lengths, CH2 bend angle, and Si5 interatomic distances
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers the paper lists for the favoured adsorption site; used as comparison reference.

hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded from the paper's reported Si6 atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge energies
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Taken from the same published table as Si5 energies; consistent with the paper's main result.

hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded from the paper's reported Si7 short_bridge energy
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Single value from the published table; used for tolerance comparison.

outputs.description: Adsorption energies for Si5 at four sites: atop_capped, atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge. The checker compares each value to the hidden gold within tolerance and verifies the short_bridge energy is highest.

units.value: Angstrom for lengths, degrees for angles

outputs.description: Structural parameters for the short-bridge Si5+ethylene complex. Parameters: C-C_bond_length, Si1-C_bond_length, Si4-C_bond_length, CH2_bend_angle, d1-2, d1-4, d4-5.
Adsorption energies for Si6 at three sites: atop_side, short_bridge, long_bridge. Checker validates values and that atop_side is highest.
Adsorption energy for Si7 short-bridge site. Checker compares to gold with tolerance and ensures positivity.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses result-level comparison: the hidden checker has the paper's reported values (adsorption energies, bond lengths, angles) and tolerances. The checker also enforces the ranking requirement for Si5 (short bridge highest) and Si6 (atop side highest).
